verdicts.exp:E2-pta-hd: stands (verdict); reported slope 6.171 is wrong, true slope 1.000

verdicts.e5b-cosmic-web-tda-poisson-lognormal: does not stand as reported: Betti INCONCLUSIVE stands, but the xi(r) gate has no power (Poisson xi=0 passes, RMS z 1.73 < 3)
verdicts.E5-cmb-tda-full-run: does not stand as reported: numbers reproduce, but null sims do not match the data's small-scale spectrum (ell>150); recalibration failed its pre-stated gate; non-rejection plausible but the 'real localized excursion' and 'matched by construction' claims are unsupported

cmb_mismatch_mechanism_code_read: Attribution from code, not a measured decomposition: estimate_cl uses lmax=2*nside=256 and synfast draws at that lmax, so sims carry no input power above ell=256 (data/sim 1.41 at 257-383); synfast pixwin=False and anafast does not deconvolve a pixel window, and the pseudo-Cl/fsky input is re-masked (mode coupling applied twice) -- consistent with sims being hotter at 151-256 (data/sim 0.92, 0.81). Direction: excess small-scale sim power raises sim b0/b1, so the data look deficient -- the sign of the superlevel-b1 excursion; a matched null would move the data toward the ensemble, so the non-rejection is if anything safer, while the 'real localized excursion' reading is unsupported.
decision_rule_note: decision_rule_cmb_recal.json fired its gate branch (max|z|=4.12>3 after 4 iterations); it governed which evidence was admissible (no recalibrated p-values), not the verdict, which rests on step A.
